Computer Vision Intern, Perception
We're building autonomous drones that see the world.

What you'll work on
- Develop object detection and tracking models (YOLO, CNNs) with PyTorch and OpenCV
- Deploy lightweight vision models on NVIDIA Jetson and other edge devices
- Build simulation pipelines (Gazebo, ROS 2) to validate perception in the loop
- Benchmark model accuracy and latency on embedded hardware

You have
- Experience with computer vision and deep learning in Python
- Experience with OpenCV and image processing
- Comfort working in Linux and with C++

Bonus
- ROS experience, SLAM or sensor fusion
- Experience with drones or robotics competitions
